name: data-table
title: DataTable
description: A virtualized table of rows on UI SDK's virtualizer, grid focus and resize: typed columns (fixed or flexible widths, a cell renderer, a sort value), sort, column resize, single selection or none, density, a size class of its own (bindSizeClass) that hides columns and stacks the rows when it is narrow, a toolbar, a footer and an EmptyState, and an optional playhead for rows on a timeline. An ARIA grid with one tab stop. Stays smooth at 100,000 rows. RequestTable and the SQL console's results are presets of it.
